ModMetaData.name: Genesis Fixes
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Small fixes, born as needed. Genesis Fixes is a catch-all mod for personal tweaks and compatibility patches - each fix lives in its own conditionally-loaded folder under "Mods", so it only applies when its target mod is active.
Fixes included: - Combat Extended Guns: files the CE Artillery Howitzer under the Ferny_Weapons designation category added by Better Architect Menu, instead of its default category. - Suppresses the harmless red "Failed to find a node with the given xpath" error that Better Architect Menu's own copy of the above patch throws in large modlists (its own edit still no-ops safely; this mod's copy above still lands the actual change). - Progression: Furniture: adds an inert stub def for GR_ScalyBearRug (Dinosauria-only content from Vanilla Genetics Expanded) so Progression: Furniture's rug-research patch stops throwing "Failed to find a node with the given xpath" when neither Dinosauria nor Biomes: Prehistoric is active. The stub is never buildable, craftable, or sellable. - Uses a guaranteed Core placeholder texture for that inert rug stub, avoiding a missing-texture error when the optional genetics content is absent. - Suppresses Progression: Arsenal's two harmless VWE_TrenchWarfare relabel errors when VFE Security is active without the separately optional Vanilla Weapons Expanded mod. - Suppresses the harmless red "Failed to find a node with the given xpath" error from Progression: Production's Appliances Expanded compat patch, which targets VFE_Manufacturing as a ThingDef when it's actually a ResearchProjectDef.
(New fixes are appended to this list as they're added - see the repo's "Mods" folder for the full set.)
